package.name: san_rth
package.description:
SkyHunter v1.5.3 — DCN-2026-017 Return-to-Home action server (C++).
Exposes /rth (combat_robot_msgs/action/ReturnToHome) so any caller (Gate-1 demo BT in DCN-2026-016, san_mission RETURN-priority branch after refactor, or a manual `ros2 action send_goal`) can trigger autonomous return to the home pose captured at boot.
Lives in its own package — NOT inside san_mission — because san_mission is the project's designated rclpy node per DCN-2026-002 D-007 (ament_python), and the v1.5.3 "C++ for all code" policy applies to NEW work without disturbing that architectural decision. Communicates with the rclpy mission node over the standard rclcpp_action wire protocol.
Features: * Home pose auto-recorded on first /odometry/filtered/global fix and persisted to /run/skyautonet/home_pose.yaml (D-081). * ±2m + 10° yaw verification at completion (D-082). * RTK loss → wheel + IMU dead-reckoning fallback when /rtk_gnss_node/heading covariance exceeds threshold for > 5s (D-083).
Refs: * DCN-2026-017 — Gate-1 (6/5) ±2m RTH accuracy + GPS-loss robustness requirement. * DCN-2026-006 EXT D-022/023 (PR-5) — RTK heading + covariance publisher used for the dead-reckoning trigger. * ADR-006 — IPC unification (rclcpp_action layer is the standard cross-language boundary).
